about: High or critical npm audit advisories accepted after review (scripts/check-audit.mjs). Each needs a reason and a reviewBy date; the check fails once that date passes, so every exception is looked at again. Remove an entry once a release fixes it.

exceptions.reason: OAuth sign-in state accepted as a magic link token (account takeover). Only a Better Auth server with magic links and a social or Generic OAuth provider is affected. This app runs no Better Auth server: Neon's hosted Neon Auth does, and no Neon Auth branch has any OAuth provider (production, development and preview checked 2026-10-29 and 2026-10-30; the testbed had Google on until it was removed on 2026-10-30, with magic links off there, and testbed/setup.mjs now keeps providers off). Never enable Google or another provider until Neon runs better-auth 1.7.7 or later. No fixed release exists yet.

OAuth Proxy plugin trusts a forged profile. Needs the OAuth Proxy plugin and cookie-stored OAuth state on the Better Auth server; Neon Auth has no OAuth providers here and the app runs no Better Auth server. No fixed release exists yet.

Device authorization approval screen lacks client details. Needs the opt-in deviceAuthorization plugin on the Better Auth server, which Neon Auth doesn't offer to this app. Fixed in better-auth 1.7.0, but @neondatabase/auth pins an older release.

Memory use when validating oversized constrained collections. Only the zod copy bundled inside @neondatabase/auth is affected; it validates responses from Neon Auth, and the app never validates its own input with zod. Fixed in zod 4.6.6, but the SDK pins an older release.
